<?php

namespace Illuminate\Support;

use Closure;
use Laravel\SerializableClosure\Support\ReflectionClosure;
use WeakMap;

class Once
{
    /**
     * The current globally used instance.
     *
     * @var static|null
     */
    protected static ?self $instance = null;

    /**
     * Indicates if the once instance is enabled.
     *
     * @var bool
     */
    protected static bool $enabled = true;

    /**
     * Create a new once instance.
     *
     * @param  \WeakMap<object, array<string, mixed>>  $values
     * @return void
     */
    protected function __construct(protected WeakMap $values)
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Create a new once instance.
     *
     * @return static
     */
    public static function instance()
    {
        return static::$instance ??= new static(new WeakMap);
    }

    /**
     * Get the value of the given onceable.
     *
     * @param  Onceable  $onceable
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function value(Onceable $onceable)
    {
        $callable = $onceable->callable;
        $trace = $onceable->trace;
        $hash = $onceable->hash;
        $object = $onceable->object;

        if (! static::$enabled) {
            return call_user_func($callable);
        }

        if (is_array($trace)) {
            $objectTarget = $trace;

            foreach (['1', 'object'] as $segment) {
                if (Arr::accessible($objectTarget) && Arr::exists($objectTarget, $segment)) {
                    $objectTarget = $objectTarget[$segment];
                } else {
                    $objectTarget = null;

                    break;
                }
            }

            $object = $objectTarget;
            $frame = $trace[0];
            $caller = $trace[1];
            $file = $frame['file'];
            $line = $frame['line'];
            $function = $caller['function'];
            $classPrefix = '';

            if (isset($caller['class'])) {
                $classPrefix = $caller['class'].'@';
            }

            $uses = [];

            if ($callable instanceof Closure) {
                $variables = (new ReflectionClosure($callable))->getClosureUsedVariables();

                foreach ($variables as $name => $argument) {
                    if (is_object($argument)) {
                        $uses[$name] = spl_object_hash($argument);
                    } else {
                        $uses[$name] = $argument;
                    }
                }
            }

            $serializedUses = serialize($uses);
            $identity = sprintf(
                '%s@%s%s:%s (%s)',
                $file,
                $classPrefix,
                $function,
                $line,
                $serializedUses,
            );
            $hash = md5($identity);
        }

        if (! is_object($object)) {
            $object = $this;
        }

        $map = $this->values;
        $bucket = [];

        if ($map->offsetExists($object)) {
            $retrieved = $map->offsetGet($object);

            if (Arr::accessible($retrieved)) {
                $bucket = $retrieved;
            }
        }

        $memoized = Collection::make($bucket);
        $items = $memoized->all();
        $exists = isset($items[$hash]);
        $hit = false;
        $cached = null;

        $memoized->when($exists, function ($collection) use ($hash, &$hit, &$cached) {
            $hit = true;
            $cached = $collection->offsetGet($hash);
        });

        if ($hit) {
            return $cached;
        }

        $resolved = call_user_func($callable);
        $memoized->put($hash, $resolved);
        $stored = $memoized->all();
        $map->offsetSet($object, $stored);

        return $resolved;
    }

    /**
     * Re-enable the once instance if it was disabled.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public static function enable()
    {
        static::$enabled = true;
    }

    /**
     * Disable the once instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public static function disable()
    {
        static::$enabled = false;
    }

    /**
     * Flush the once instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public static function flush()
    {
        static::$instance = null;
    }
}

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in src/Illuminate/Support/Once.php:131 — `isset($items[$hash])` returns false for a cached `null` value, causing the callback to re-run. Replaced it with `array_key_exists($hash, $items)`, which correctly detects null-cached entries.

All 21 `OnceTest` tests pass, and the full Support suite passes (the 5 errors are pre-existing failures due to the missing `intl` PHP extension, unrelated to this change).
